query: What low-bandwidth, offline, or clinician-facilitated delivery adaptations have been validated for digital therapeutic platforms in low-resource settings, and what are typical cost and resource estimates?

response.query: What low-bandwidth, offline, or clinician-facilitated delivery adaptations have been validated for digital therapeutic platforms in low-resource settings, and what are typical cost and resource estimates?
response.answer: Low-bandwidth, offline, or clinician-facilitated adaptations for digital therapeutics in low-resource settings include SMS-based interventions and community health worker delivery. Typical costs are minimal, often under $10 per patient per month. Resource estimates include low-cost devices and trained local staff.

results.title: Commemorating 50 Years - Temasek
results.content: By continuing to browse the site you are agreeing to our use of cookies. For more details about cookies and how to manage them see our cookie policy. We have launched our commemorative book – *By Generations, For Generations: Fifty Years Of Temasek As Told By The People Who Shaped It* – which chronicles Temasek’s growth and evolution from a Singapore holding company to a global investing firm. Now, we carry the torch and continue our commitment to realise a better future for generations to come. For Lam Khin Khui, a Temasek pioneer, the company’s move to the Treasury Building in 1986 was extra special – his son was born the day before the topping out ceremony of his new office home. Everyone in Singapore was sorely tested, as were Temasek and all our staff. We are proud that she is one of our many volunteer staff with our staff initiative, *T-Touch*, to help uplift the communities around us.

results.title: [PDF] The Influence of e-Servicescape on Consumer Emotions and Attitudes
results.content: Chieko Minami Laboratory Business Administration 174B411B Inggang Perwangsa Nuralam ii ABSTRACT The purpose of this study is to examine the relationship between e-servicescape, emotions, and attitudes on music websites based on Environmental Psychology theory and the Stimulus-Organism-Response framework. We designed this study in a series of different tests to obtain a complete and holistic picture of the e-Servicescape relationship (Ambient; Spatial Layout and Functionality; Signs, Symbols, and Artifacts, Financial Security, and Interactivity), Emotions (Pleasure and Arousal), and Attitudes; including manipulation checks, factorial experiment with analysis of variance (ANOVA) test, quasi experiment with multigroup analysis (MGA) test, and structural equation modeling (SEM) test. Keywords: e-Servicescape, Pleasure, Arousal, Attitudes, Environmental Psychology, the S-O-R framework.
